30 seconds. 3 simple props. One fun activity to build focus + coordination! 🤩

Looking for an easy activity to keep your little one active at home? Try this!

You’ll need:
• Cones or cups
• Balls
• Hula hoops

How to play:
Arrange the hoops one after another like a caterpillar
a. Place cones on either
side, with balls beside them.
Now, let your child jump from hoop to hoop, collect the balls, and bring them back to the centre!

Make it more challenging:
Change the position of the hoops or cones, increase the distance, or switch up the movement pattern to keep those little minds and bodies engaged! 

A simple setup that encourages coordination, concentration, movement, and problem-solving-all while having fun!
